content.text:
GeoArm Taxi — live prices and schedule (Tbilisi ⇄ Yerevan)
Currencies: GEL, USD, AMD
Cars (car id: seats; price per passenger; whole vehicle):
- sedan = sedan: 4 seats; 100 GEL / 42 USD / 14000 AMD per passenger; whole vehicle 400 GEL
- minivan = minivan: 7 seats; 70 GEL / 29 USD / 10000 AMD per passenger; whole vehicle 450 GEL
- sprinter = minibus (a seat on the scheduled minibus): 18 seats; 60 GEL / 25 USD / 8500 AMD per passenger; whole vehicle 900 GEL
Tbilisi → Yerevan (dir tbs-evn):
- departure points (point id = name): avl = Tbilisi — Ortachala (Hotel Takhlaura, in front of the bus station); tbs-air = Tbilisi airport
- departure times: 09:00, 11:00, 13:00, 15:00, 17:00, 19:00
Yerevan → Tbilisi (dir evn-tbs):
- departure points (point id = name): evn-x = Yerevan — Railway station; evn-air = Zvartnots airport; lwn = Gyumri airport
- departure times: 09:00, 11:00, 13:00, 15:00, 17:00, 19:00
Pick-up from an address: point "@addr" with `address` (extra fee, confirmed by the dispatcher).
Facts: The ride takes 5–6 hours and crosses the border at Sadakhlo–Bagratashen. Payment is in cash to the driver; nothing is paid online.
A booking is a request: it is NOT confirmed until a GeoArm Taxi dispatcher contacts the passenger to confirm it.
